title: Every Lay’s® chip has a backstory. It starts with a potato.
summary: Lay’s potatoes begin in the field and end in everyday moments of connection, with trusted quality and flavors made for consumers around the world.
body_markdown:
When you’re moving roughly 4 billion pounds of potatoes each year, knowing the growers and the fields matters. Teams help move potatoes through the network while balancing growing seasons, regional supply, what consumers are buying and quality requirements. Weather, timing and supply chain conditions are always changing, which means the work is a constant puzzle — one focused on delivering potatoes that meet the right standards for size, color and consistency.


Once potatoes are sourced, logistics teams move them to production sites as efficiently as possible, using trucks or refrigerated train cars depending on the season and route. During peak harvest periods, some potatoes go directly from the field to production facilities, while others are stored by farmers in specially designed barns until they are needed.


At the production site, the process moves quickly. Potatoes are cleaned, sliced, cooked, seasoned and packaged — often within 48 to 72 hours of arriving. Quality checks happen throughout the process, helping ensure every bag of Lay’s potato chips meets the standards consumers expect.


## How Lay’s creates potato chip flavors


Once the chip is right, flavor teams build on that base. Lay’s begins with a plain potato chip, then draws inspiration from food culture, familiar favorites and regional tastes around the world.


“Lay’s are probably the perfect base for flavor development because it’s a beautiful palette,” said Ann Robarge, senior principal scientist, who has spent her career in R&D product development.


The process blends creativity with a close understanding of what people love to eat. Teams test and refine flavor ideas, then rely on consumer feedback to understand what resonates. Around the world, that work helps Lay’s show up in ways that feel both familiar and locally relevant — whether through a classic flavor people already love or a new taste inspired by how people eat and share food in different parts of the world.


## How Lay’s stays familiar around the world


The same care that goes into the chip also shapes how Lay’s shows up around the world. From packaging to retail displays to food experiences, teams work to make the brand feel recognizable, warm and connected to its roots.
